# toTextAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`TextAlignmentInput`](text-alignment-input.md) to the [`TextAlignment`](text-alignment.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toTextAlignment(input: TextAlignmentToken | TextAlignment): TextAlignment
```
